calls.description: Who calls whom, in the order the calls happen. Down: what it calls. Up: what calls it. The data going in and coming back sits on the selected card's lines.

contains.description: What's inside what: boxes inside boxes, no lines. Go into a box to make it the whole screen.

data_flow.description: Where data goes: cards are data types, the functions that turn one into another sit on the lines. Down: where it goes. Up: where it came from.
